name: MatchNode
doc: Graph-node search settings. The clip field references a cooked motion database.

fields.name: query
fields.doc: Float parameter names in the database's raw feature order.

fields.name: budget
fields.doc: Maximum candidate rows examined per search; zero requests an exact full scan.

fields.name: continuation
fields.doc: Keep playback when the selected frame is this many ticks from its continuation.
